risks.risk: The item is not a real product being sold — it is a stock image from a catalog or manufacturer, not a physical item in the seller’s possession.
risks.proof: A photo of the actual item in the seller’s possession, showing the cover on a real sofa with visible wear, tags, or packaging.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic, unverified item — likely overpriced for a stock photo, and may not exist.

risks.risk: The cover may not fit the buyer’s sofa due to size or shape differences (e.g., arm style, depth).
risks.proof: A photo of the cover on the actual sofa the seller owns, or a measurement chart showing dimensions.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a one-size-fits-all item — may not fit, reducing value.

risks.risk: Water resistance claim is unproven — the material may not repel water as advertised.
risks.proof: A video or photo showing water being poured on the fabric and beading off, or a close-up of the material’s texture and weave.

proof_requests: Photo of the actual cover on a real sofa in your possession, showing all sides and fit.
Close-up of the fabric material to verify texture and water resistance.
Measurements of the cover (length, width, depth, arm coverage).
Proof of brand or packaging if available.
response.reason: The photos are promotional stock images, not real product shots. The brand and water resistance claims cannot be verified. Without proof of the actual item, its fit, material, and authenticity, a price cannot be determined. The seller must provide real photos of the item they are selling.
